posts.title: Cooking In Place: Pesto, Zucchini and Beans
posts.description: It’s been a while since I’ve posted and I apologize. posts.title: In My Kitchen: Cooking In Place: What I Found In My Freezer
posts.description: I have a small freestanding freezer that doesn’t self-defrost, and yesterday I decided to defrost it. It wasn’t really a pandemic-related stay-at-home activity, as I have to do it every few months anyway. And every time I do so, I discover something good that I’d long since forgotten about.
